**Tier 1.** Its `application`, `domain` and
`infrastructure` may import only a strictly lower tier. `http/` composes freely
but may never reach into another module's `http/` or `infrastructure/`.

May import: `activity`, `plugins`, `settings`.

Currently imports: `plugins`, `settings`.

Feature map entry: `gallery` in [docs/features.json](../../../docs/features.json). Run `npm run feature -- gallery` for its full span.

## Invariants

<!-- invariants:start -->

The server is authoritative for stock. Availability shown to a customer is
imported quantity less live holds and unshipped allocations, and a cart or
checkout must re-check it rather than trusting what the gallery displayed.

Catalogue data enters only through the documented import path from
`catalog import tree`. Nothing here may read manager data at runtime.

<!-- invariants:end -->
